summary: You mentioned two different deadlines, Friday and then Thursday, so this plan assumes Thursday until you confirm. You also have no savings, and the easiest person to borrow from is a roommate you are not speaking to right now. Once the date is settled, the rest can be put in order.

issues.title: No savings to fall back on
Not on speaking terms with your roommate

priorities.action: Check the deadline in writing: the course page, the syllabus, the original email, or a quick message to a classmate
priorities.reason: Until you know, plan for Thursday. Working to the earlier date costs you a day; working to the later one could cost you the grade.

priorities.action: Decide whether you are ready to talk to your roommate, separately from the money
priorities.reason: Asking for money while you are not speaking can make both harder. Clearing the air first, or finding another option, may work better.

priorities.action: Write down what you need money for in the next two weeks, and how much
priorities.reason: Knowing the exact amount tells you whether you need to borrow at all, and makes asking anyone much easier.

next_action.text: Check the course page or your email for the deadline, or ask a classmate who would know.
next_action.why: The deadline is the one fact that changes the whole plan, and a single message settles it.

clarifying_questions.question: Which day is the deadline: Thursday 1 October or Friday 2 October?
Roughly how much money do you need, and by when?
Would you feel OK asking your roommate for help right now?
